typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  	MEMBER_ID  	,MEMBER_LNAME	 	,MEMBER_FNAME	 	,MEMBER_DOB	 	,PCP_NAME    	,PCP_ADDRESS 	,PCP_PHONE 	,PCP_ID 	,PCP_NPI 	,PCP_TIN  	,PROVIDER_CPC  from [Data_Exchange].[EXTRACT].[OH_RISE_TOC_Extract]  ##OH_TOC_EXTRACT',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SourceTableOHRISETOCEXTRACT
SourceTableOHRISETOCEXTRACT sink(input(
		PCP_ID as string,
		MEMBER_FNAME as string,
		PCP_PHONE as string,
		PCP_ADDRESS as string,
		MEMBER_ID as string,
		MEMBER_LNAME as string,
		PCP_TIN as string,
		MEMBER_DOB as string,
		PCP_NAME as string,
		PCP_NPI as string,
		PROVIDER_CPC as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PCP_ID,
		MEMBER_FNAME,
		PCP_PHONE,
		PCP_ADDRESS,
		MEMBER_ID,
		MEMBER_LNAME,
		PCP_TIN,
		MEMBER_DOB,
		PCP_NAME,
		PCP_NPI,
		PROVIDER_CPC)) ~> FlatFilePCP
